verdict.rationale: Autumn calls itself an open-source control layer, and its GitHub repo shows the full product running locally with `bun dev`, serving the dashboard at localhost:3000. That shows you can run the core product yourself. However, the evidence only covers a local dev setup, not a documented production self-hosting path. Missing for 10: production self-hosting/deployment docs (Docker, infrastructure requirements, configuration), feature-parity statement versus the cloud offering, independent or hands-on self-hosting reports.
